MORE: Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing  Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Schedule III of the said Regulations, we inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e., Friday, August 14, 2026, inter alia, has approved the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report as enclosed below.
